operations.summary: SearchAvailability using a fixed Square API request.
operations.description:
Searches for availabilities for booking.

To call this endpoint with buyer-level permissions, set `APPOINTMENTS_READ` for the OAuth scope.
To call this endpoint with seller-level permissions, set `APPOINTMENTS_ALL_READ` and `APPOINTMENTS_READ` for the OAuth scope.

operations.summary: BulkRetrieveBookings using a fixed Square API request.
operations.description:
Bulk-Retrieves a list of bookings by booking IDs.

To call this endpoint with buyer-level permissions, set `APPOINTMENTS_READ` for the OAuth scope.
To call this endpoint with seller-level permissions, set `APPOINTMENTS_ALL_READ` and `APPOINTMENTS_READ` for the OAuth scope.

operations.summary: SearchTeamMembers using a fixed Square API request.
operations.description:
Returns a paginated list of `TeamMember` objects for a business. 
The list can be filtered by location IDs, `ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE` status, or whether

operations.summary: SearchTerminalActions using a fixed Square API request.
operations.description: Retrieves a filtered list of Terminal action requests created by the account making the request. Terminal action requests are available for 30 days.

operations.description: Returns a filtered list of Terminal checkout requests created by the application making the request. Only Terminal checkout requests created for the merchant scoped to the OAuth token are returned. Terminal checkout requests are available for 30 days.
